tools.name: find_property

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: The full listing for a property id: description, location, check-in and check-out times, capacity, pets, amenities, house rules, photos, nightly pricing and fees.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Booked nights and the open date ranges a stay can actually be booked in, with minimum-stay rules applied. Defaults to the next 90 days; at most 365 days per call. Ranges are check-in inclusive, check-out exclusive.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The exact price of a stay: nightly rates, discounts, cleaning and other fees, taxes and total, in integer cents.
